lines: Midnight. Rain. She walked in with flour on her hands... and a copycat problem.
Every post I make, the bakery across the street copies by morning.
Then we watch her. Public pages only. Five free tools.
Two AM. She changed her prices. We knew in sixty seconds.
Two A.M. She changed her prices. We knew in sixty seconds.
She's launching a lavender croissant... on Friday?
Then you launch yours on Thursday.
A year of copying me... and now she's a day behind.
